\section{Claim register}\label{sec:claims}
\subsection{Right-ideal semantics}\hypertarget{claim:semantics}{}\backmap
\textbf{LEAN.} Literal ordered membership and quotient right-action operation in the original ring. SupportDimension proves zero-quotient/membership equivalence and consumes explicit bottom-dimension/support/zero equivalences. TerminalBoundary extracts literal original-U cofactors from a supplied zero quotient or membership witness, while Package/Opposite transports left S1 to right S1 in the opposite ring and conversely. The actual filtered-class encoding and characteristic-support construction remain open M01 work.

\emph{Source:} SymplecticStafford/Semantics/Contract.lean; SymplecticStafford/Semantics/S1Consequences.lean; SymplecticStafford/Semantics/SupportDimension.lean; SymplecticStafford/Package/TerminalBoundary.lean; SymplecticStafford/Package/Opposite.lean.
\emph{Review:} Implemented semantic checkpoint and explicit opposite transport; the filtered-class and universal producer hypotheses remain open. Replay logs and precise types govern scope.

No incoming claim dependency in this graph.
\subsection{Ordered utilities}\hypertarget{claim:ordered}{}\backmap
\textbf{LEAN.} Affine expansion, conditional finite constant-right-denominator clearing, and actual ordered common-colon sets K and J with right-ideal closure. CommonColon and SupportUnion prove the central pencil identity, finite-span algebra and conditional inclusion/support-union interfaces. Finite generators, polynomial localization and the stated support theorem remain M08 obligations.

\emph{Source:} SymplecticStafford/Ordered/Affine.lean; SymplecticStafford/Ordered/RightClear.lean; SymplecticStafford/Ordered/CommonColon.lean; SymplecticStafford/Ordered/SupportUnion.lean.
\emph{Review:} Implemented checkpoint; replay logs and precise types govern its scope.

No incoming claim dependency in this graph.
\subsection{Scalar-pencil utility}\hypertarget{claim:scalar}{}\backmap
\textbf{LEAN.} Finite exceptional scalars and simultaneous forbidden-set avoidance for finite division-ring coordinates with nonzero starting coordinates. PencilBridge, ActivatedPencil, DivisionLLD and RadicalLift conditionally infer top-to-cyclic, finite affine-source or finite top-lifting consequences from supplied data. Repeated simple factors, matrix blocks, radical construction and the arbitrary finite-length activation theorem remain open M06–M07 work.

\emph{Source:} SymplecticStafford/FiniteLength/Pencil.lean; SymplecticStafford/FiniteLength/PencilBridge.lean; SymplecticStafford/FiniteLength/ActivatedPencil.lean; SymplecticStafford/Source/DivisionLLD.lean; SymplecticStafford/FiniteLength/RadicalLift.lean.
\emph{Review:} The coordinate theorem is implemented; CyclicTopBridge is a conditional consumer. Replay logs and precise types govern both scopes.

No incoming claim dependency in this graph.
\subsection{Chart contract}\hypertarget{claim:local-scaffold}{}\backmap
\textbf{LEAN-SCAFFOLD.} A supplied exhaustive multiplicative filtration and map preserve degree bounds; assumed chart-wide power right-clearability gives finite common right clearance. ReesBasic and ReesQuotient prove raw bounded-term reindexing, quotient operations and coherence, while WeightedDetection handles a supplied finite integer-weighted triangular system. These do not yet construct the algebraic Rees ring, full-symbol Ore localization, characteristic support or faithful good-module detection.

\emph{Source:} SymplecticStafford/Filtered/Localization.lean; SymplecticStafford/Filtered/ReesBasic.lean; SymplecticStafford/Filtered/ReesQuotient.lean; SymplecticStafford/Filtered/WeightedDetection.lean.
\emph{Review:} Conditional checkpoint consumer; right\_clearable is an input field. M02–M05 remain open.

Dependencies: \hyperlink{claim:ordered}{Ordered utilities}.
\subsection{Divisor-indexed assembly}\hypertarget{claim:assembly-scaffold}{}\backmap
\textbf{LEAN-SCAFFOLD.} Given DivisorIndexedAssembly with a source and literal original cofactors for every nonzero divisor, extract SameDivisorS1. Sources may depend on d. OriginalTestContract records the M06 original-U finite-test/source witness shape and routes only a supplied composite producer to this consumer. This supplies no instance or producer; finite CandidateFamily and uniform SingleSourceAssembly are optional toy contracts.

\emph{Source:} SymplecticStafford/Source/Assembly.lean; SymplecticStafford/Source/OriginalTestContract.lean.
\emph{Review:} Conditional checkpoint consumer of supplied identity fields; M06 and M08–M11 remain open.

Dependencies: \hyperlink{claim:semantics}{Right-ideal semantics}.
\subsection{Strong P\_h contracts}\hypertarget{claim:ph-scaffold}{}\backmap
\textbf{LEAN-SCAFFOLD.} Record affine source membership, abstract finite generation tests, integer defect bounds, both lower-index calls and supplied successor output. TestRetention makes carried lists, old/new component bookkeeping and defect arithmetic explicit; FiniteIndex composes supplied P\_1 and successor rules to P\_(D+1), including D=0. Terminal cofactors still require supplied zero extraction; actual support, the base and the two-call successor remain open.

\emph{Source:} SymplecticStafford/Induction/StrongPh.lean; SymplecticStafford/Induction/FiniteIndex.lean; SymplecticStafford/Induction/TestRetention.lean.
\emph{Review:} Conditional checkpoint: localization/module specifications, defect and generation predicates, successor output and zero\_extraction are supplied. M09–M11 are not proved.

No incoming claim dependency in this graph.
\subsection{Finite-length boundary}\hypertarget{claim:length-scaffold}{}\backmap
\textbf{LEAN-SCAFFOLD.} MinimalPrimeLength wraps composition-series and finite-length closure facts and, given a supplied local model with Noetherian and Artinian hypotheses at a minimal support point, derives finite length and finite generation. It constructs no characteristic support, localization or minimal-prime theorem.

\emph{Source:} SymplecticStafford/FiniteLength/MinimalPrimeLength.lean.
\emph{Review:} Conditional checkpoint: local support point, surjective model, Noetherianity and Artinianity are supplied; M05 construction remains open.
